posts.title: Rewrite my text in a clear, friendly tone
posts.body:
Rewrite the text below so it is clear, friendly and under 150 words. Keep every fact. Do not add new claims.

Text:
"""
[paste text]
"""

posts.title: Turn rough notes into a meeting summary
posts.body:
Turn these notes into a summary with three sections: Decisions, Action items (owner + due date), Open questions. If an owner or date is missing, write "unassigned".

Notes:
"""
[paste notes]
"""

posts.title: Review a document and list what is unclear
posts.body:
Read the document below as a first-time reader. List every passage that is ambiguous, unsupported or contradictory. Quote the passage, explain the problem in one sentence, and suggest a fix.

<document>
[paste]
</document>

posts.title: Explain a concept at three levels
posts.body: Explain [concept] three times: to a ten-year-old, to a college student, and to a practitioner. Keep each under 120 words and use a different example each time.

posts.title: Describe an image for alt text
posts.body: Look at the attached image and write alt text of at most 125 characters. Describe what matters for someone who cannot see it. Do not start with "image of".

posts.title: Compare two documents
posts.body: Compare the two attached documents. Give a table of differences (topic, document A, document B) and a three-sentence summary of which is stronger and why.

posts.title: Summarise a topic with pros, cons and open questions
posts.body: Give me a balanced briefing on [topic]: the strongest argument for, the strongest argument against, and the three questions experts still disagree on. Keep it under 250 words.

posts.title: Draft a short, punchy post
posts.body: Write five versions of a post (max 240 characters) announcing [thing]. Vary the tone: plain, witty, urgent, curious, understated.

posts.title: Step-by-step plan from a goal
posts.body: My goal: [goal]. I have [time] per week. Create a 4-week plan with weekly milestones and a daily 20-minute task list. End with the one thing most likely to derail it.

posts.title: Rewrite code comments
posts.body:
Improve the comments in this code. Explain why, not what. Do not change the code itself.

```
[paste code]
```

posts.title: Translate and keep the register
posts.body: Translate the text into [language]. Keep the same level of formality, keep idioms natural rather than literal, and list any phrase you were unsure about at the end.

posts.title: Extract structured data from text
posts.body:
Extract the following fields from the text as JSON: name, date (ISO 8601), amount, currency. Use null when a field is missing. Return only JSON.

Text:
"""
[paste]
"""

posts.title: Solve a problem and check the answer
posts.body:
Solve the problem below. Show the reasoning step by step, then verify the result by a different method. If the two disagree, find the error.

Problem: [problem]

posts.title: Debug with a minimal reproduction
posts.body:
Here is a bug and the code around it. Propose three likely causes ranked by probability, then give the smallest test that would confirm or rule out each.

```
[paste]
```

posts.title: Bilingual glossary
posts.body: Create a glossary of the 15 most important terms in [field], with the English term, the [language] term, and a one-line definition in both languages.

posts.title: Turn a spec into test cases
posts.body:
From the specification below, write test cases as a table: id, input, expected result, edge case (yes/no). Include at least five edge cases.

[paste spec]

posts.title: Turn a document into slide outline
posts.body: Create a slide outline from the document: one title slide, five content slides with three bullets each, one summary slide. Suggest a speaker note for each slide.

posts.title: Clean up a spreadsheet column
posts.body: I have a column of messy names in Excel. Give me a formula or steps to trim spaces, fix capitalisation and remove duplicates without losing the original column.

posts.title: Source-checked briefing
posts.body: Give me a briefing on [topic] using only sources from the last 12 months. For every claim, add the source. Flag any claim supported by only one source.

posts.title: Compare options with citations
posts.body: Compare [option A] and [option B] for [use case]. Use a table with price, main strengths, main weaknesses. Cite a source for each cell.

posts.title: Cinematic product shot
posts.body: Minimalist ceramic coffee mug on a walnut table, soft morning window light, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, muted warm palette --ar 4:5 --style raw

posts.title: Flat illustration for a blog header
posts.body: Flat vector illustration of a person organising floating notes into a glowing grid, limited palette of indigo, cream and coral, generous negative space --ar 16:9

posts.title: Photoreal portrait lighting recipe
posts.body: Portrait of an elderly fisherman, weathered skin, natural overcast light, 50mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. Negative: blurry, extra fingers, watermark, text. Steps 30, CFG 6.

posts.title: Isometric room illustration
posts.body: Isometric cutaway of a cosy reading room, warm lamp light, plants, clean linework, soft pastel colours, high detail. Negative: lowres, clutter, text.

posts.title: Short, strict instruction for small models
posts.body: You are a careful assistant. Answer in at most three sentences. If you do not know, say "I don't know". Question: [question]

posts.title: Classify text with a fixed label set
posts.body:
Classify the text into exactly one label: billing, bug, feature_request, other. Reply with the label only.

Text: [paste]

posts.title: Ask for clarifying questions first
posts.body: Before you answer, ask me up to five questions that would most improve your answer. Wait for my replies. Task: [task]

posts.title: Critique then improve
posts.body:
Here is my draft. First list the three biggest weaknesses. Then rewrite it fixing only those three things.

"""
[paste draft]
"""
